title: Micro heatmap bench notes and quick run ledger
content:
Purpose: quick personal ledger for small session runs — capture heatmap-style buckets (seq x batch) and jot actionable next steps. Informal notes, not a finished report.

Run table (rows = seq_len bucket, cols = batch size). p50/p95 measured on dedicated dev rig (A5000), single-stream concurrent=4, cold start disabled. Cost is rough token-equivalent USD per 1k tokens assuming spot rates.

| run | model | seq | batch | quant | p50_ms | p95_ms | cpu% | cost_per_1k_usd | notes |
| R1  | opt-6.7b | 256 | 1 | fp16 | 34 | 68 | 12 | 0.16 | baseline small seq single-batch |
| R2  | opt-6.7b | 512 | 2 | q4_0 | 48 | 120 | 28 | 0.09 | q4 latency penalty visible at p95 |
| R3  | Llama-2-7b | 1024 | 4 | q8_0 | 110 | 270 | 55 | 0.06 | KV-cache warms helpful; p95 high on tails |
| R4  | Mistral-7b | 2048 | 2 | fp16 | 240 | 640 | 78 | 0.12 | memory thrash on >1k, consider batch=1 |
| R5  | opt-6.7b | 512 | 4 | q4_0 | 95 | 210 | 40 | 0.05 | batching helps throughput but p95 still spikes

Heatmap notes (quick):
- Short seq (<300): steady p50 but p95 sensitive to interleaving with other jobs — isolation helps.
- Mid seq (500-1k): quantization gives big cost wins; watch p95 regression vs fp16.
- Long seq (>1k): memory/page thrash risk on smaller GPUs; batching can actually increase p95 dramatically.

Quick ASCII heatmap sketch (green=good, yellow=iffy, red=bad):
Seq/B  1     2     4
256    [G]   [G]   [Y]
512    [G]   [Y]   [Y]
1024   [Y]   [R]   [R]
2048   [R]   [R]   [R]

Notes-to-self (short bullets):
- Re-run R2 with pinned thread affinity (INF-342) to check if p95 drops ~10-15ms.
- Try q4_1 (different quant kernel) on R3 to see if p95 improves w/o cost spike.
- Add a tiny synthetic tail test (random token insertions) to reproduce p95 spikes and attach to PR #498.
- Capture CPU/GPU mem graphs next run (use perfprobe snippet in slack #infra-bench).

Action items:
- [ ] Run quick A/B: q4_0 vs q4_1 on opt-6.7b for seq=512 batch=2 (target: 3 repeats, collect p50/p95/cpu). Owner: Anjali. Due: 2026-03-15.
- [ ] Share heatmap snapshot with Marcus before infra retro.
- [ ] If q4_1 improves, open draft note for product about recommending quant profile for mid-seq workloads.

Context / caveats:
- These numbers are dev rig only; do not expose as official benchmark. Use for ops tuning and quick prioritization.
- Cost calc uses toy rate 0.00016 USD/token-1k equivalent for fp16 baseline; normalize when moving to dedicated pricing.
